description: Verification code input, with multiple slots and paste support.

howToUse: Use it for the code sent by SMS, e-mail or an authenticator app.
Set `length` to the size of the code, and `groupSize` to split long codes ("392 114").
Verify in `onComplete`, which fires when the last digit is filled. Show `error` when the code is wrong, and a resend link below.
Your application sends and checks the code, and controls expiry and attempts.
alternatives: A password or any free text: Input.

keyboard.action: Fills the boxes in order; a pasted code fills all of them.
Moves to the previous or next box.
Deletes the digit and goes back one box.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled code (string with up to `length` characters).

props.name: onChange
props.description: Fired on each keystroke with the current code.

props.name: onComplete
props.description: Fired when every digit is filled.

props.name: alphanumeric
props.description: Accepts letters besides numbers. Default digits only.

props.name: autoFocus
props.description: Focuses the first field on mount.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Defines a string value that labels the current element.
